product_launches.description: Infracost launched InfraCarbon, a new feature within Infracost Cloud that uses Greenpixie emissions data to show developers the carbon impact of their infrastructure changes alongside cost estimates in pull requests.

overview_description.description: Infracost shifts cloud costs left, making FinOps proactive rather than reactive. Integrated directly into the engineering workflow, it displays the cost impact of infrastructure-as-code (IaC) changes before deployment to production. This approach catches costly mistakes before any money is spent. Additionally, Infracost verifies that all resources comply with your established tagging policy and evaluates code against our FinOps policy packs to ensure best practices are followed.
